title: Zesty Jammy Mirepoix Ethiopian Fettuccine Kik Alicha
description: A classic Ethiopian dish made with fettuccine, mirepoix, and a tangy sauce. Serve hot on a stone plate for an authentic experience.
instructions: Heat the ghee or oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped mirepoix and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the spiced Berbere powder, cumin, turmeric, salt, and black pepper. Cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the milk and stir to combine. Bring to a simmer and cook until the sauce thickens, about 5 minutes.
Add the cooked fettuccine to the skillet and toss to combine with the sauce.
Stir in the chopped cilantro and crushed Habanero pepper. Season with salt to taste.
Serve hot on a stone plate, topped with additional cilantro and a squeeze of fresh lemon juice.
If desired, add a dollop of butter or non-dairy butter on top of the fettuccine.
Garnish with a sprinkle of Berbere powder and a few fresh cilantro leaves.
